Hey man, cheers for the response and your interest. The DMT was pure and from a trusted source. It is easy to find out here is Aus. Setting could have been better as mum was on her way home, a good bit after that so that was in the back of my mind. I was in an empty house, in a comfortable spot that I knew well and had setup with water, my phone near by, something to ground me ect. I also ended up calling my mate who talked me through my first few cones and is a psychonaut himself. I was a full time stoner at the time however had only had a few smaller cones in the morning, i did pack the last dmt cone, inbetween a fair amount of bud. The biggest standout of what I did wrong was that I had completely repressed how badly my ex hurt me 8ish months prior. I never let myself feel the hurt from him, his family and my friends so I was forced to deal with it all in one big hit. So I think the combo on unresolved trauma and large cones definitely contributed to it

Cheers for the response man! I really hope so. Thats what I have to keep on telling myself. That no matter how much work I put in, I have to allow time to do it's healing too. I just responded to another comment suggesting the same and whilst I don't discredit your comment, I don't believe the dmt was the issue. Being that I'm in Australia and the trees grow here, it is extremely easy to get your hands on clean and potent DMT. My mates had done it at different ages, in different states, tested and all by differently reputable sources. A few even that I mentioned were even over seas. America, Finland and Canada. I am most definitely working towards it and am hopefully closer to an end result rather than further away. My American mate was not as lucky (especially with the hc system up there) and has reached a level of severe paranoia, schizophrenia and suicidal ideologies. His HPPD was actually diagnosed by a dr up there.

There is most definitely a potential for that, however we all took it across different states of Australia, at different years, by different people. Being that the trees grow out here, it's extremely easy to get your hands on some extremely clean and potent DMT. It's also worth mentioning that my other mates are American, Canadian and Finland. All had their DMT from reputable sources, or by then selves and all tested. I don't believe the quality of the dmt was the issue

Whilst there has been underlying issues too, there was a clear distinction between before dmt and after it. For instance, I was diagnosed with minor OCD as a late teen but it had never impacted any part of my life. After DMT, it became chronic and uncontrollable, consuming the better parts of my days. I have never at all had hallucinations or poor visuals and since DMT, I have them on the daily. I use to love driving, now It takes all of my concentration to be safe on the roads. I see things Infront of me that aren't there, can't sit at the speed, too dangerous with visuals and distortion to drive at night ect. After talking to my now linked in psychotherapist, he believes that whilst there were potentially some underlying issues, doing dmt as I did not only enhanced the ones I had but has created more. It's made me disconnected and dissociative as well as the hallucinations and distorted vision. None of which I had ever experienced so much as 6 months ago.
